description: This is a source file for a Swift actor named 'MacNodeBrowserProxy' which provides network proxy functionalities for handling requests related to nodes on a Mac, including request construction, response handling, file payload management, and HTTP communication.

classes.name: MacNodeBrowserProxy
classes.description: An actor responsible for proxying network requests for Mac nodes, managing request parameters, handling file payloads, and communicating with a local server endpoint.

classes.name: Endpoint
classes.description: A structure holding the base URL, token, and password for API endpoint configuration.

classes.name: RequestParams
classes.description: Decodable structure representing parameters for network requests.

classes.name: ProxyFilePayload
classes.description: Represents file payloads with base64 encoding, including path, mime type, and conversion to JSON format.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request based on given JSON parameters, processes the response data, and returns a JSON string containing the result and associated files.

methods.name: defaultEndpoint
methods.description: Generates the default endpoint configuration with local settings.

methods.name: decodeRequestParams
methods.description: Decodes JSON string into RequestParams object.

methods.name: makeRequest
methods.description: Constructs a URLRequest based on request parameters and endpoint info.

methods.name: requireHTTPResponse
methods.description: Validates that a URLResponse is an HTTPURLResponse.

methods.name: httpErrorMessage
methods.description: Creates an error message string from HTTP status code and response data.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Converts an Any value to String, handling common types.

methods.name: loadProxyFiles
methods.description: Loads proxy files from a result object by collecting paths and reading file data.

methods.name: collectProxyPaths
methods.description: Recursively collects file paths from a nested payload object.

methods.name: loadProxyFile
methods.description: Loads metadata and content of a proxy file at a given path, encoding file data as Base64.
